snippet.title: Brand New ZX81 / ZX-81 game : Mayhem (2011)
snippet.description:
A brand new game release by Revival Studios for the Sinclair ZX81 computer, called Mayhem. Starring Clive Junior. Clive Junior's latest invention went terribly wrong! It exploded and all kinds of parts are flying across the room!

Your goal is clear and simple: Avoid the debris while running around and picking up parts to gain points! 

For more information, visit the game's website at: www.revival-studios.com

A brand new game by Revival Studios for the Commodore PET / CBM Pet home computer.

Available on cassette tape and as digital download

For more information about the game, visit: http://www.revival-studios.com

Follow me on twitter @revival_studios for the latest updates

Trailer music by: 4mat (CC)

Trailermusic by: Buskerdroid (CC)
